_comment: Copied to <your-projects-root>/<project>/seo-audit/config.json on the first run. Never commit a real config to the agent folder. country filters Search Console only ('all' or empty = no filter); serp_country is the two-letter code for live SERP fetches (empty = country when it is a real code, else project-context geography.country, else 'us'). crawl: start_url (default: the domain's home page), max_pages, delay_s between requests, as_origin to audit a local build with production URLs. repo_path: optional path of the site's source repository; it turns on repo mode (scripts/repo_fix.py): each fixable defect traced to its file and line as a patch checked by git apply, never applied, the repository only read. briefs.top: refresh briefs written per run. geo: draws per question and surface, surfaces to measure, provider per surface (perplexity, command, manual, none), command = the founder's answer-engine CLI for the command provider, competitors (name, aliases, domains), brand_aliases. gsc_bands, crawl_rules and eeat override keys of assets/gsc-bands.json, assets/crawl-rules.json and assets/eeat-weights.json for this project only (an eeat override changes the scores: write it in Methodology). Optional, same merge: a links object overrides assets/link-rules.json (scripts/links.py), a topics object assets/topics-rules.json (scripts/topics.py), a write object assets/write-rules.json (scripts/write_article.py: thresholds, assemble.url_pattern, frontmatter presets, plus author and publisher of the JSON-LD). Optional: a tools object (same keys as shared/tools.example.json, e.g. {"serp": "builtin", "search_console": "manual", "ai_answers": "manual"}) pins providers for this agent. Every API is optional.
target_queries: primary query the site should rank for
